newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Tallinn Pharma in 29 mln kroon 96 profit.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Tallinn Pharma in 29 mln kroon 96 profit.

text.p: Estonian drugs maker Tallinn Pharmaceutical, a leading share on the stock exchange, said on Wednesday it made a net profit of 29.5 million kroons in 1996 after pre-tax earnings of 37 million kroons.
The company in a statement also forecast a net profit of 38.5 million kroons in 1997 on sales of 200 million kroons.
In 1995, the company made a net profit of 16.4 million kroons. It also said that at a shareholders meeting in April it would propose a dividend of 1.5 kroons per share.
"The profit forecast is based on sales contracts which have been signed or are about to be signed," the company said.
The firm said that earlier this month it signed a production deal with a regional medicines factory that would raise sales volume by 30 million kroons this year.
It said that it invested 15.3 million kroons in new production equipment in 1996 and that planned investments in 1997 were 20 million kroons.
